title: Earth AI for public health: geospatial models across five use cases
summary: The PDFM model increased the explained variance in MMR vaccination coverage from 16% to 22% across 146 counties on the US–Canada border, and improved weekly correct cholera-risk-area rankings in the DRC from 1.78 to 2.10. Gains for cardiovascular mortality and postpartum depression were small or not significant.

evidence.tested: Five partner-led evaluations compared PDFM embeddings with baselines: MMR explained variance rose from 16% to 22% across 146 border counties and cholera Precision@5 improved from 1.78 to 2.10; cardiovascular gains were not significant.
evidence.unknown: Several results were non-significant or small, cholera gains were not significant at one or two weeks, and the authors cite static embeddings as a limitation.
evidence.ai_role: PDFM combines search trends, mobility, built-environment and environmental data into location embeddings used without task fine-tuning; for dengue it was paired with TimesFM 2.0.
